item.title: I Fixed a Bug in OpenClaw Dreaming — The Regex That Broke the Memory System
item.description: Background OpenClaw’s Dreaming feature (background memory consolidation) is an experimental capability designed to: Light Phase: Scan recent memory files, extract key content into the short-term recall store REM Phase: Deduplicate and cluster the recall store Deep Phase: For sufficiently rich recall, call the LLM to generate a deep summary, write to DREAMS.md, and optionally promote it to MEMORY.md Configured to run automatically at 04:00 daily (customizable).
